source_atom_index_policy: Atom indices are the original RDKit indices of original_input_smiles_source for the source parent record. Every mapping is bound to that exact SMILES and its source SHA-256. Product indices are never assumed to equal parent indices.

product_constraints.retention_denominator: Frozen per-parent count of original heavy atoms after excluding each original terminal CF3 carbon and its three fluorines. All other original atoms, including fluorines, remain in the denominator.
product_constraints.count_retained_atoms: Only chemically identical, correctly mapped original atoms with preserved connectivity among retained protected atoms count. Atoms in the declared editable set are not credited merely because a generated atom has the same element.
protected_core: Mapped original atom identity and element
Mapped stereochemical configuration; CIP label change alone is not an inversion
product_constraints.anchor_policy: New connections and hydrogen-count changes may occur only at declared boundary anchors or within the declared editable region.
product_constraints.new_stereocentres: Must be specified before acceptance; unspecified outputs remain incomplete.
product_constraints.chemical_state_identity: Tautomers, protonation states, and stereoisomers are separately counted records linked to a design family and proposal lineage; conformers are linked geometries. State/stereoisomer enumeration consumes the proposal budget.

mask_grammar.F0: Terminal CF3 group for each qualifying parent site.
mask_grammar.F1: Graph-distance-1 neighbourhood around a CF3-bearing site.
mask_grammar.F2: Graph-distance-2 and graph-distance-3 neighbourhoods around a CF3-bearing site.
mask_grammar.F3: Each complete ring system containing a CF3-bearing attachment atom; fused/overlapping rings are treated as one ring system.
mask_grammar.F4: Each connected parent domain on the CF3-bearing side of a single acyclic bridge-bond cut.
mask_grammar.coordination: Choose one applicable primary region per CF3 site and union them with every original fluorine atom. Preserve disconnected region labels and individual region descriptors.
mask_grammar.validity: Retained complement must meet the frozen atom threshold and have at least one boundary bond/anchor. Final products must be connected and contain zero fluorine.
mask_grammar.deduplication: Deduplicate identical editable source-atom sets per parent; preserve the full set of class labels and region provenance.
mask_grammar.rejection_log: Record every generated grammar mask rejected for retention, invalid region, no boundary, or other declared rule, with its rule and reason.
mask_grammar.scope_statement: Complete within this bounded grammar only; not every possible connected subgraph.
